items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is excluded under 2.1 and 3.1.4. Sections 4.3(d)–(f) and 4.5 also exclude personal belongings in a car away from the insured location, so the payable threshold is €0.
There was no insured event, and sections 5.2.5 and 7.1.8(d) independently exclude vehicle and journey charges; no covered debris transport or agreed call-out is shown. The payable threshold is €0.
